reviews.title: 6399 STORE IS A FAILURE WITH CUSTOMER SERVICE
reviews.text:
Chanel or whatever her name was rude on her tone in giving out information. Their shop was the one who called me to call back and when I did, the person who answered was straight up rushing. Your app says I can pay EXTRA for shipping but the store was telling me they do not do shipping. Basically that personnel is lying because I did a same day shipping before through the app and received my orders. Please clarify this with your staff and if that store does not truly do same day shipping, REMOVE them from the choices. If I could give a zero star on this service, I WOULD.

I called back and Jolene assisted. She may not be the main manager but she was more helpful and gave better instruction. Please retrain the other “Manager” basically can’t explain in layman’s term to customers on their services. Again, she was not yelling but her tone is not the best. If you have to put too much information and rushing at the same time, customer is just gonna get confused because why would you mention a third party company (internal service), when I ordered through the app. You’ll confuse more people. Just straight up say, delivery personnel will pick up and deliver. No need to mention Uber or whatever because that’s an internal information.

reviews.title: Lifetime warranty
reviews.text:
I have been doing business with AutoZone for 20+ years. 
I purposely purchase the lifetime warrantied parts for the reason they upsell them. Problem is they don’t like to honor the lifetime warranty on parts, they change part numbers and suppliers so that the employees are powerless to honor a warranty because that part is no longer in there computer or has a different part number than when you purchased it. 

What’s the point of the lifetime warranty if you can’t make use of it?

reviews.title: Super bad customer service from the store manager
reviews.text:
Will not be visiting this location ever again. My car was running hot and I pulled to this auto zone to get some “ all seal “. I only had a $100 bill, the manager of the store “ Alex M. “ refuse to break the $100 so a good samaritan broke the $100 for me. so I put the $20 on the counter. Mind you, the manager had an attitude from the start. He said he “ refuses service before I had an “ attitude “  
My friend that was with me kept asking him what’s the problem we for change now you don’t wanna service us .. and he’s like well “ ask her “ skip to the chaos, he called me a raggedy b@$&, make racist comments and also was pulling at his pants like he was going to pull something out. The situation doesn’t sit well with me at all. As a manager, you show professionalism and etc.
I got nothing but curse words. 
I want him FIRED. I know I am not the only one who has an issue with this guy. I’m unsure what the discrimination was about but I feel like since he’s gay & I’m a girl that’s why it went the way it did. 
If you’re big on how you receive customer service then you understand where I’m coming from. 
There’s more to it & there is also witnesses. He needs to be fired or stepped down from the manager position because that’s not how you talk to nor treat a customer .. 
I want my money back & I will NEVER visit that location again

reviews.title: Next day delivery is BS
reviews.text: Ordered Thursday with free next day delivery for Friday so that I would have the parts for the weekend. Never came Friday and updated Saturday to show a Monday delivery. Called customer service but they couldn’t cancel the order or make it in store pick up because it was shipped already. Unacceptable. If you can’t do it, don’t say you can. These are common items, belts and such, that are available in store, but now I have to purchase them again and deal with the hassle of trying to return the ordered items. The store acts like anything through the app is a different business they can’t control. Never had these issues at other parts stores.

reviews.title: Don’t use this if you want more than four of something
reviews.text: For the most part, the app is good and it’s nice to be able to find all of your parts before you get to the store. However, when you need more than four of something, they should let you purchase more. I can’t just replace for spark plugs in my truck I need six but getting more than four online isn’t available. It’s not that they didn’t have enough, you can only order a maximum quantity of four of something that’s just ridiculous.
